items.quote: he lived there because he was afraid of his brother Abimelek.
items.contrast: Jotham stayed because he feared his brother Abimelek, not the citizens of Shechem.
items.reason: The window directly states the cause of Jotham’s staying in Beer. The citizens of Shechem appear later as opponents of Abimelek, but they are not identified as the people Jotham feared.
